body.note: Packet proposal followed. Directly after parts/p15/integration-expectation would sit next to the example and boundary entry it completes; lead may prefer that.

existing_treatments_not_listed: thm:p15-stirling-poisson-premises (Poisson normalization, mean, E[X(X-1)], variance); cited and extended
annex:p15.coupon-collector-law geometric moment calculation (r = 1, 2, by differentiation); cited via thm:p15-coupon-collector-law
def:p15-countable-waiting (geometric law with p = 1/2); used in the worked example

thm:p15-holder-integral (integration-expectation.tex 268-279) contains the inequality of Durrett Exercise 1.5.1 as its p=1 case, and its annex proof contains the essential-bound argument; linked from thm:p15-w02b-p15-001-lp-results
thm:p15-conditional-lp / def:p15-lp-conditional-spaces (conditional-expectation.tex 131-156): L^p norm laws on probability spaces; linked
def:p15-uniform-integrability, thm:p15-ui-small-sets: small-event control for families on probability spaces; linked from the small-set part
proposed_decisions: lambda: Poisson parameter scoped to sec:p15-w02b-p15-001-poisson-geometric; same role as def:p15-stirling-poisson-laws; distinct from Lebesgue measure (sec:p15-measure-extension) and gamma rate (sec:p15-convolution-gamma-normal).
N, p, q: geometric variable, success probability, q = 1-p, scoped to the chapter; q matches annex:p15.coupon-collector-law usage.

L^p(mu), \mathcal L^p(mu): scoped to sec:p15-w02b-p15-001-lp, general measure; same notation as L^p(G) of def:p15-lp-conditional-spaces (probability space). Proposed: treat as the general-measure parent of that notation.
Lebesgue measure is named in words in this chapter because lambda is the chapter-wide Poisson parameter.
bib: No new keys; DurrettPTEAuthor2019 already in handbook.bib. No intake bib written.
